pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal regions with highly irregular, jagged boundaries. Edge gradients are sharp, exhibiting significant crenellation. Spatial area of individual patches is relatively smaller on the neck, expanding into broader, more defined geometric shapes on the lateral flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of thick, cream-colored interstitial pathways. The topology features frequent tri-nodal junction points and maintains a relatively consistent pixel thickness throughout the visible area, providing high contrast against the dark brown patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous 1D silhouette of the mane showing high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. The crest follows the contour of the neck and shoulder with a consistent, finely textured edge.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized region of hyper-pigmentation and textural density located on the posterior dorsal ridge. This area is characterized by a concentration of smaller, darker, and more tightly packed patches compared to the surrounding anatomy.
